description: This file defines an internal sealed class LruGrainDirectoryCache implementing the IGrainDirectoryCache interface. It extends a concurrent LRU cache to manage grain addresses with a maximum size, providing methods for adding, updating, removing, and looking up grain address entries, along with enumerating all key-value pairs.

classes.name: LruGrainDirectoryCache
classes.description: A cached implementation for grain directory entries using an LRU cache strategy, keyed by GrainId, storing activation address and version.

methods.name: AddOrUpdate
methods.description: Adds a new or updates an existing grain address entry with a specified version.

methods.name: Remove (by GrainId)
methods.description: Removes the cache entry identified by the specified GrainId.

methods.name: Remove (by GrainAddress)
methods.description: Removes the cache entry matching the given GrainAddress, using a match predicate.

methods.name: LookUp
methods.description: Retrieves the activation address and version for a given GrainId if it exists in the cache.
